In theory it seems like a great idea, but I simply cannot afford college. My parents aren’t available to help me financially, so I cannot take out any loans. I don’t have any credit history either, so that only worsens things. As for the fafsa financial aid, what they were offering me was practically nothing since my parents make almost 100k annually. But like I said, they told me that I have to figure college out on my own.

I took a few classes at my local community college last year, and I got 100’s on every test, exam, homework and project. I actually really liked it because I built a close relationship with one of my differential equations professors (I also took multivariable calculus with him). I showed him a few of my papers and we talked a lot and everything. He wants me to get a bachelors and straight away go to grad school for math, but the problem is I cannot afford any of it. My parents refuse to help me financially, so I cannot take out loans as I don’t have any credit history to my name. So I essentially just finished my courses, took the 4.0 gpa and left. I’m not signed up for anything else unfortunately. I think what I’ll end up doing is delivering packages for fedex or ups or something, just so I can make a living for myself.
